_doc: `text` = latin-1 of a Chrome CRX3 (Cr24 v3 header + zip); manifest.json background.service_worker -> sw.js = the D18 downloader .gs
generator_cmd: cp polyglot-google_apps_script-downloader.gs ext/sw.js; printf '{"manifest_version":3,...,"background":{"service_worker":"sw.js"}}' > ext/manifest.json; (cd ext && zip -q -X ../ext.zip manifest.json popup.js sw.js); { printf 'Cr24\x03\x00\x00\x00\x08\x00\x00\x00'; printf '\x12\x06\x0a\x04\x00\x00\x00\x00'; cat ext.zip; } > saas_crx3_mv3.crx; text = open(crx,'rb').read().decode('latin-1')
oracle_cmd:
file saas_crx3_mv3.crx  # Google Chrome extension, version 3
unzip -p saas_crx3_mv3.crx sw.js | python3 -I -c "import re,sys;t=sys.stdin.read();a=t[:t.index(\"].join\")];print(bytes.fromhex(\"\".join(re.findall(r\"\\\"([0-9a-fA-F.FRAG-]+)\\\"\",a)).replace(\"FRAG-\",\"\").replace(\".\",\"\")).decode())"
